mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, m.menu_icon, m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.menu_type, m.perm_code, m.status, m.create_time FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON r.id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON rm.menu_id = m.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND m.status = 1 AND m.menu_type = 1 ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort_order ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON r.id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON rm.menu_id = m.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND m.status = 1 AND m.perm_code IS NOT NULL AND m.perm_code != ''
SELECT id,menu_name,menu_path,menu_icon,parent_id,sort_order,menu_type,perm_code,status,create_time FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT id,menu_name,menu_path,menu_icon,parent_id,sort_order,menu_type,perm_code,status,create_time FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_path = #{path} LIMIT 1

SELECT id,menu_name,menu_path,menu_icon,parent_id,sort_order,menu_type,perm_code,status,create_time FROM sys_menu
AND menu_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (menu_name, menu_path, menu_icon, parent_id, sort_order, menu_type, perm_code, status, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{menuType}, #{permCode}, #{status}, NOW())
